article.title: 國泰推出Cathay Lifestyle，整合日常生活及旅遊服務
article.summary: 國泰公布Cathay Lifestyle品牌，將旅遊生活業務的產品、服務及體驗放在同一品牌之下。
highlights: 組合涵蓋購物、支付、保險、假期及亞洲萬里通里數的賺取與兌換。
國泰表示，品牌希望增加會員在旅程以外接觸國泰的機會。
article.why: 旅遊及零售品牌可重新檢視會員日常接觸點，找出哪些服務適合由同一會員關係連結。
article.next_step: 列出會員出行前、旅途中及日常生活的接觸點，逐項核對合作商戶與里數規則。
article.detail: 國泰的新聞稿把Cathay Lifestyle定位為高端旅遊生活業務品牌，並以更清晰的品牌架構統合已持續擴展的生活服務。公告提及品牌商品及餐飲合作等既有發展。行銷團隊可以由品牌識別和服務導覽開始檢視，確認會員能否理解每項服務、合作方及里數的適用條款。
article.title_en: Cathay launches Cathay Lifestyle to unite travel and everyday services
article.summary_en: Cathay announced Cathay Lifestyle as a brand bringing its premium travel lifestyle products, services and experiences together.
highlights_en: The portfolio spans shopping, payment, insurance, holidays and Asia Miles earning and redemption.
Cathay says the brand aims to add member touchpoints beyond journeys.
article.why_en: Travel and retail brands can review everyday member touchpoints and identify services that fit one membership relationship.
article.next_step_en: Map touchpoints before, during and outside trips, then check partner and mileage rules for each.
article.detail_en: Cathay's release positions Cathay Lifestyle as a clearer brand structure for its expanding lifestyle business and refers to existing merchandise and dining partnerships. Marketing teams can review brand identity and service navigation to see whether members understand each offering, its partner and the applicable mileage terms.
